root.label: House Judiciary Committee Denver and Boulder sanctuary jurisdictions report

events.label: House Judiciary Committee Denver and Boulder sanctuary jurisdictions report

slots.name: report length
slots.sentence: The latest is a 25-page report that accuses top prosecutors in Denver and Boulder of helping illegal immigrants evade Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), while also revealing for the first time the names and graphic charges against some of those whom House GOP investigators say are being shielded from President Donald Trump's federal crackdown.

slots.name: domestic violence people
slots.sentence: At least four illegal immigrants were arrested due to alleged domestic violence in Denver but also had their ICE detainers ignored, the report said.

slots.name: sentence length
slots.sentence: Under Boulder County’s approach, the Sheriff complied with state law and, ultimately, Contreras was held fully accountable by the prosecutors in our office and sent to state prison for eight (8) years.

slots.name: ICE notice hours
slots.sentence: In Boulder, "Mario Hernandez-Quiroz, a Mexican national arrested for child abuse and failure to appear," was among those whose ICE detainer was ignored.
